MIND. [1] [Asaf.]
Consciousness unaffected. θ Chorea.
Fits of joy with bursts of laughter. θ Hysteria.
Ill humor, irritable mood, dislike to work. θ Caries.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Asaf.]
Very sensitive and excitable ; all perception of senses lessened, but not consciousness.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Asaf.]
A sudden pain in left temple, like an inward-pressing pointed plug.
Pressive pain in forehead and left side of head from within outward.
Single, sudden, and deep penetrating stitches under left frontal eminence, like shocks followed by some sensitiveness.
Rush of blood to head, and warmth of face.
Congestive headache.
All headaches < towards evening, in room, while at rest, sitting or lying ; > when rising or moving about in open air.
Nervous headache of hysterical or scrofulous people.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Asaf.]
Pain in right parietal, as from a deeply penetrating plug.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Asaf.]
Mist before eyes.
Boring pain above eyebrows ; burning, especially at night. θ Iritis, kerato-iritis, retinitis, of syphilitic origin.
Burning in eyeballs ; in left as from within outward.
Sharp pain extending through eye into head, upon touching.
Nocturnal, throbbing pains in and around eye and head. θ Syphilitic iritis, abuse of mercury.
Deep-seated inflammation of eyeball, attended by ciliary pains. θ Iritis, kerato-iritis, irido-choroiditis and retinitis, especially if of syphilitic origin.
Extensive superficial ulceration of cornea, with burning, sticking or pressing pains, from within outward ; rest and pressure relieve ; also > in open air ; numbness around eye.
Periodic burning in eyes and pressing together of lids ; as if overcome with sleep.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Asaf.]
Hardness of hearing, with thin, purulent discharge of an extremely offensive odor. θ After scarlatina, or abuse of mercury.
Otorrhœa with offensive discharge and diseased bones.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Asaf.]
Offensive discharge from nose ; stench from nose. θ After mercury or in scrofula.
Discharge of very offensive matter from nose ; with caries of bones. θ Ozæna.
Numbness of bones of face ; painless tension in various places.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Asaf.]
Swelling of lower lip.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Asaf.]
Grinding of teeth ; starting at night ; transient griping pains in region of navel. θ Chorea.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Asaf.]
Speech unintelligible ; tongue white, swollen. θ Chorea.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Asaf.]
Constantly chewing and working frothy slime out of mouth, with swollen tongue. θ Chorea.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Asaf.]
Sensation as if peristaltic motion was reversed and œsophagus being drawn from stomach up towards throat.
Burning, followed by soreness, in fauces and pharynx.
Sensation of a ball rising in throat, causes difficulty in breathing. θ Hysteria.
In evening a hysterical rising in throat, as if a ball or large body ascended from stomach to œsophagus, or even pharynx, obliging him repeatedly to attempt to swallow it. θ Globus hystericus.
Dryness and burning in œsophagus.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Asaf.]
Great disgust for all food. θ Chorea.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Asaf.]
Great dejection, with epigastric pressure after eating : hypochondriacal.
After eating : heat in face, with anguish ; pressure in stomach ; stitches about lower ribs ; tension in abdomen ; winding and twisting in bowels ; great difficulty in breathing ; febrile state.
After drinking : diarrhœa ; heaviness and cold feeling in intestines.
After eating anything sour griping pains in region of navel. θ Chorea.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Asaf.]
Eructations : smelling like garlic ; tasting rancid, sharp, or putrid ; smelling like feces ; tasting like carrion.
Flatus passing upward, none down.
Hiccough-like contractions of diaphragm. θ Chorea.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Asaf.]
Pressing, cutting, stitching pains in spells, not regular ; full of wind ; pressing upward (never down) ; gulping up rancid fluid ; constipation. θ Gastralgia.
Dyspepsia, with much pulsation in pit of stomach.
Pulsation in pit of stomach, perceptible to sight and touch.
"Gone," empty feeling in pit of stomach, not a pain, but "it hurts there ;" pulsations after eating ; < about 11 o'clock A. M. ; faint feeling. θ Hysteria.
Meteorism of stomach when feeling of tension is great and eructating is difficult.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Asaf.]
Heat in spleen and abdomen.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Asaf.]
Gastric and abdominal sufferings, accompanied by pulsations in epigastrium.
Wind colic, with abdominal pulsations ; very painful distension of abdomen, rumbling ; relieved by passing wind.
Abdomen soft, distended. θ Chorea.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Asaf.]
Watery, liquid stools of most disgusting smell ; pains in abdomen and discharge of fetid flatus.
Watery stools of disgusting odor ; discharge profuse and greenish.
Blackish-brown, papescent, offensive stools, which relieve.
Pain in perineum, as from something dull pressing out.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Asaf.]
Urine warm and of a pungent, ammoniacal smell.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Asaf.]
Excited sexual desire. θ Nymphomania in a plethoric woman.
Bearing down in genitals, < when riding in a carriage.
Uterine ulcer, sensitive and painful, with offensive discharge.
Menses too early, too scanty, and last but a short time.
Labor-like pains in uterine region, with cutting and bearing down.
Leucorrhœa profuse, greenish, thin and offensive.
Swelling and inflammation of genitals.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Asaf.]
Mamma turgid with milk, like in ninth month ; without being pregnant.
Deficient of milk, with oversensitiveness.
Ten days after delivery milk diminished ; 14th day only a few drops could be squeezed out with difficulty ; after 5 drops of tincture, copious milk, but offensive to child ; 3d centesimal answered as well.
Milk had disappeared within three weeks of her delivery ; six confinements.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Asaf.]
Spasm of glottis, alternating with contraction of fingers and toes. θ Hysteria.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Asaf.]
Asthmatic feeling in trachea, dry cough ; spasmodic dyspnœa as if lungs could not be sufficiently expanded.
Oppression of chest increasing to agony, cannot breathe, restless moving about.
Oppression of chest, with hurried breathing ; contracted, small pulse, or, frequent pulse ; asthma after too hearty a meal ; too great exertion.
Asthmatic attacks at least one a day all her life, brought on by every bodily exertion, coition, especially by every satisfying meal.
   

COUGH. [27] [Asaf.]
Obstinate titillating cough, < at night, with grown persons.
Whooping cough, even of sucklings, sounding like croup ; rattling breathing, anxious and restless, chest and abdomen hot, urine pale.
Hoarse ringing short cough, excited by tickling in trachea, with asthmatic feeling therein ; spasmodic contraction of thorax and accumulation of stringy mucus.
Cough, with cessation of sputa.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Asaf.]
Pressure and burning under sternum ; frequent disposition to cough.
Compression of chest, as from a heavy weight. See 26.
Oppressive aching feeling in chest ; > from expectorating mucus.
Pressive pain in right side of chest, from within outward.
Pressure in left intercostal muscles, from within outward, < during inspiration and expectoration.
Stitches in chest from within outward. θ Whooping cough.
Burning in chest, runs through both arms and through lower limbs down into toes.
Single violent stitches from within outward, at short intervals ; renewed when chest is touched. θ Pleuro-pneumonia.
Dropsy of chest ; relieved the oppression in 6, 12, or 36 hours ; 3d every 2 or 4 hours.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Asaf.]
Palpitation, with faintness, rush of blood to head, flushing of face, anxiety and slow breathing, from excitement. θ Irritable heart.
Acute rheumatic heart disease, with tightness across chest. θ Hydrothorax.
Slight palpitation of heart, more like a tremor, several times when sitting.
Nervous palpitation, with small pulse ; from overexertion or suppression of discharges (in women).
Pressure in region of heart, as if heart was too full and expanded ; pulse small.
Pulse small, spasmodically contracted, rather quick. θ Chorea.
Small, infrequent pulse, with violent action of heart and no disturbance of respiration indicating nervous weakness of organ.
Pulse small, rapid, irregular. See 28.
Pulse accelerated, but unequal, small. θ Asthma, congestion to heart, etc.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Asaf.]
Fine, burning stitches in and behind r. scapula, extending towards ribs.
Cannot work on account of backache.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Asaf.]
Child always missed laying hold of anything she wished. θ Chorea.
Whitlow, violent nightly pains, threatened necrosis.
Aching, drawing in wrist joints. θ Syphilis.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Asaf.]
Carious ulcer on tibia, extremely sore around, discharge offensive ; skin adheres to bone.
Child, æt. 9, could not walk. θ Chorea.
Swelling around ankle joint, cannot use foot.
Psoitis if suppuration seems impending ; also if pelvic bones are involved.
Pain as if a splinter of bone was sticking in right fibula, just above outer malleolus. θ After a sprain.
Cold swelling around ankles.
A sensitive throbbing in left great toe from time to time.
Painful throbbing in tip of great toe.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Asaf.]
Constant convulsive tremor of limbs, could be > by hands of another person. θ Chorea.
Twitching of muscles of arms and legs.
Pains mostly on flexor sides of limbs.
   

NERVES. [36] [Asaf.]
Hysteria, with much trouble about throat or œsophagus ; well-marked globus hystericus ; spasms of lungs, etc.
Twitching and jerking of muscles.
Nervous affections after suppressed discharges.
Epileptiform convulsions caused by worms.
Chorea.
Clumsiness of body ; feeling of rigor.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Asaf.]
Sleeplessness after midnight. (Conium before midnight).
About midnight violent pains through left half of body, from top to toe.
Pain in ulcer at night, almost unendurable.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Asaf.]
Crushing pain regularly < from evening till 2 A. M. θ Neuralgia after amputation.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Asaf.]
Venous pulsations ; congestion of portal vein ; congestive fulness about heart and chest, with asthma ; heat of face and ears, after eating ; pressure on chest, etc. ; copious discharges ; all signs of fulness of venous system.
Dropsy, ascites, from abdominal venous stasis.
Obesity ; seldom of use in bone diseases unless body is heavy, bloated.
Scraping sensation on bones ; whole body puffed.
Caries in scrofulous, and after abuse of mercury.
Glands hard, swollen, hot and throbbing, with shooting, jerking pains ; scrofulous complaints.
Osteitis, caries, bluish redness and swelling of parts.
Soft enlargement of bones, also curvature.
Nightly bone pains in syphilis.
Bones threatened by syphilis. θ Iritis.
Caries of bones ; adhesion of skin in caries.
Scrofulous caries of bones, even necrosis.
Ulcers with fetid, ichorous, bloody, serous pus ; with bluish, partly raised edges, painful to slightest touch.
Ulcers deep, flat, fistulous, affecting bone.
   

SKIN. [46] [Asaf.]
Sphacelus.
Ulcers with extreme sensitiveness ; patient flinches from even the softest dressing ; or from near approach of any one.
Ulcers with high, hard, bluish edges, sensitive to touch, easily bleeding ; pus profuse, greenish, thin, offensive, even ichorous. See 44.
Shooting pain around ulcer.
Ulcers grow black.
Old scars break open and turn black.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Asaf.]
Phlegmatic temperament.
Scrofulous, bloated, clumsy children.
Venous, hemorrhoidal constitutions.
Nervous people.
Syphilitic patients who have taken much mercury.
Girl, æt. 9, chorea.
Woman, æt. 21, in sixth week after first confinement not milk enough, after third could nurse full nine months.
A multipara, æt. 34 ; milk had disappeared tenth day in seven confinements.
